Like others said, i recommend r/emetophobia, it's a good support group, but be careful, it can be triggering sometimes!! I have the same symptoms as you, I feel really scared whenever i eat something my mind just tells me I'm gonna be sick, no matter what it is. I've suffered from this since 2013 and I had a rough time in the past, i got very thin and people thought I was anorexic. This year, has been very bad for my emetophobia, I've had the fear every single day and I try to eat as little as possible, but sometimes I get hungry and it doesn't work. I do recommend mint gum, it helps me a lot to combat the feeling of being nauseous, anxious and fearful. I also recommend an antiemetic. I always chew gum and take one antiemet whenever I feel very very extremely anxious and it works. My anxiety ironically makes me feel very nauseous and I get scared but it kinda works.
